newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Over 350 reported killed in Bangladesh cyclone.
newsitem.headline: Over 350 reported killed in Bangladesh cyclone.

text.p: More than 350 people died in three offshore islands and in Cox's Bazar district when a severe cyclone swept Bangladesh's flat coastal region on Monday, newspaper reporters in Chittagong said.
They said over 100 people were killed in the islands of Maheshkhali, Kutubdia and Saint Martin's. Some 250 others had been killed in Cox's Bazar, one of the areas worst hit by Monday's cyclone.
Unofficial sources said some 2,000 people were injured in Chittagong port city alone and that about 100 fishermen from THE coastal district of Patuakhali were missing at sea.
Official sources confirmed only nine deaths and more than 100 injured in Chittagong, but said the figures could go up when details of the devastation would be available on Tuesday.
The cyclone, roaring in from the Bay of Bengal, ravaged Chittagong, Cox's Bazar and Tenkaf districts and several islands, leaving a trail of devastation.
"It's difficult to estimate losses of lives and property in dark. All affected areas have been without electricity and many without telecommunications since evening," one Chittagong official said.
